resources.string: Last card went back to box 1. You will see it again tomorrow.
You reviewed %1$d cards and reached your goal of %2$d. Rest is part of learning; your next cards will be ready tomorrow.
Every word at this difficulty is scheduled for a later day. Add a word, choose a harder level, or come back tomorrow.
Your cards could not be loaded.
The app stops when you reach this number. Short, regular sessions help memory more than long ones.
Plays the word when its card appears, using the dictionary recording or your device’s voice. Off by default.
Your progress and answer history are stored only on this device. WordWise has no account, ads or tracking.
This deletes your answer history and card progress on this device. Your word collection stays. This cannot be undone.
Word list: Academic Word List, Sublist 1 (Coxhead, 2000). Definitions for words you add: Wiktionary, via the Free Dictionary API.
Look up a word you met in your reading and add the meaning you need to your collection.
Only the word you type is sent to dictionaryapi.dev. Your progress and history stay on this device.
No definition was found. Check the spelling or try a different form of the word.
Type a single English word or short phrase, using letters only.
You seem to be offline. Your saved words still work; try the lookup again when you are connected.
The dictionary is not responding right now. Please try again later.
Added to your collection. It will appear in your next session.
This word is already in your collection.
The pronunciation could not be played. Check that a text-to-speech voice is installed in your device settings.
The dictionary’s recording isn’t available, so your device’s voice read the word.
